subject: Activation stuck — supplier portal shows success but login fails
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@avalonsupplies.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@avalonsupplies.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Activation stuck — supplier portal shows success but login fails

Hi Markus,

We completed the supplier activation via the link your team sent (Coupa confirms activation). When my team tries to log in to the portal we immediately get redirected to the login page with no error message — it looks like the account never persists. I tried Chrome and Edge. Screenshot attached (activation_screenshot.png).

We also attempted to upload our W‑9 but the upload dialog never completes. We need to get a PO in place for the onboarding order this week — can we pause issuance until login is fixed?

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Head of Procurement
Avalon Supplies
Attachments: activation_screenshot.png
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@avalonsupplies.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:02:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation stuck — supplier portal shows success but login fails

Hi Oliver — thanks for the details and the screenshot. Sorry for the friction here.

Quick checklist while we investigate:
- Can you confirm whether you accepted the activation from the same device/browser where you later tried to log in?
- Are you seeing a brief flash of a welcome page before the redirect, or does it go straight to the login form?
- If possible, please try an Incognito window (this rules out extension/cookie issues).

Looping in Ben (portal ops) and Marissa (onboarding) to help triage. If this can’t be resolved in the next few hours we can issue a manual PO hold and complete vendor creation on our side so you can get paid. If you can attach any portal logs (portal_logs.txt) that will speed troubleshooting.

I’ll follow up once Ben and Marissa confirm next steps.

— Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@avalonsupplies.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:45:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation stuck — supplier portal shows success but login fails

Hi Oliver — Ben from Portal Ops here. Thanks for the screenshot. A few things we can try now:

1) Please open an Incognito/Private window and attempt login to https://coupa.example.com.
2) If that fails, please go to https://coupa.example.com/support-logs and download the client logs (save as portal_logs.txt) and attach them in reply.
3) If you’re on a corporate network, temporarily try from a phone hotspot (some strict proxies strip cookies/relaystate).

I’ve generated a one‑time reactivation link below (expires in 2 hours) — try that in an Incognito window: https://coupa.example.com/s/activation/abc123/reauth.

If reactivation fails, reply with portal_logs.txt. I’ve attached a stub (portal_logs.txt) template for what we need; please replace with the real log.

If we can’t get you logged in quickly, Marissa can accept the W‑9 on your behalf and we’ll create a manual vendor entry so tomorrow’s PO can go out.

— Ben
Portal Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: portal_logs.txt (please attach real log)
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@avalonsupplies.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@avalonsupplies.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:12:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation stuck — supplier portal shows success but login fails

Hi Ben / team —

Tried the reactivation link in Incognito (Chrome) and it still redirects back to the login form without any error. I tried from my phone hotspot as well — same behaviour. I exported the logs from the portal support page and attached them (portal_logs.txt). I’ve also attached the completed W‑9 (w9_filled.pdf) in case you need to upload it manually.

Portal logs: attached (portal_logs.txt)
W‑9: attached (w9_filled.pdf)

Please let me know when you can either enable access or accept the W‑9 on your side. We’re on a tight timeline for the initial PO.

Best,
Oliver
Attachments: portal_logs.txt, w9_filled.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@avalonsupplies.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 15:30:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation stuck — supplier portal shows success but login fails

Hi Oliver — thanks for the logs and the W‑9. I reviewed the portal_logs.txt and it looks like the activation webhook completed but our session cookie never persisted due to an edge case with SameSite handling on certain proxy chains. I’ve opened an engineering ticket: SUPPORT-4782 (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SUPPORT-4782) and added the logs.

Immediate remediation:
- I’ve manually created the vendor record in our system and uploaded your W‑9 on your behalf so we can proceed with procurement. You should see Vendor ID: AVALON‑786 in our system.
- We issued a manual PO hold release for the onboarding order; procurement should see the PO request flow through now.
- Engineering will deploy a fix for the cookie handling tomorrow morning; Ben will follow up with validation steps.

Action items for you:
- Try to sign in once more after 09:00 PT tomorrow; if you still get redirected, send a short screen recording.
- If you prefer, sign the attached supplier agreement via DocuSign link (https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=5f8a2c) — I added you as signatory.

Sorry again for the friction — we’ll confirm once the engineering fix is live. Let me know if you need the manual PO number now and I’ll share it.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: (W‑9 uploaded by Redwood on your behalf)
